original.notes: Single released February 5, 2021, about seven minutes, also on Dansband & Bugg Medley. Songwriting credits include Chuck Berry, Leiber & Stoller, Eddie Cochran and John Fogerty.

recipes.tips: Channel A for the Chuck Berry and Eddie Cochran boogie rhythm (root-fifth to root-sixth shuffle on the low strings). Channel B, a brighter AC30 crunch, for the Creedence parts. For a Gretsch-like Cochran twang, pull the tone knob (single coil). It's a seven-minute medley for dancing: keep the groove steady and the palm muting light.
recipes.why: A small tweed amp turned up with a slapback echo is the classic 50s rock 'n' roll rhythm sound. A modern dansband production keeps it tight, so the echo and room reverb stay short.

original.notes: Single released February 5, 2021. Songwriting credits include Chuck Berry, Leiber & Stoller, Eddie Cochran and John Fogerty.

recipes.tips: Channel A for Chuck Berry-style double-stop intros and fills, channel B, a Plexi crunch, for the bigger solos. Stomp the Tube OD for more sustain. Pull the tone knob (single coil) for brighter, twangier fills.
recipes.why: An AC30 crunch with a slapback echo covers the Chuck Berry double stops. The Plexi-style channel gives the solos more weight without going past classic rock 'n' roll grit.
